articles.summary: Open World and VerifyMe sign a 60-day exclusive LOI for a proposed Nasdaq merger, with Open World holders expected to own 90% and breakup fees up to $500,000.
articles.title: Token Economy Leader Open World and VerifyMe Announce Plans to List on Nasdaq via Proposed Strategic Merger

articles.summary: VerifyMe and Open World sign a 60-day LOI for a strategic merger that could leave Open World with 90% of the company and enable a pre-close cash dividend.
articles.title: VerifyMe and Token Economy Leader Open World Announces Plan for Strategic Merger
